_note: V1 hand annotation of Nagaraja et al., pedicle screw system under compression-bending (ASME V&V 40), by Claude. Written before running any router against it.
_source: Establishing finite element model credibility of a pedicle screw system under compression-bending
_selection_rule: Nagaraja reproduces the V&V 40 gradation table at length, and those definitions read exactly like findings in isolation -- 'Test conditions were not characterized or were characterized with gross observations' is gradation (a), not something this study did. Every span below therefore names what THIS study did: 'each modeler', a product, or a number. Factors whose only matches were gradation text are omitted rather than annotated wrongly.
